data.research_question: What direct Trump–Netanyahu ventures exist, and what adjacent Israeli commercial network is source-backed?
data.method: Entity resolution and depth-3 public-source graph expansion.
classification_rules: Count a direct joint venture only when both Trump and Netanyahu are documented owners, partners or contractual commercial counterparties.
Do not count political endorsement, government diplomacy, family friendship or brand adjacency as a commercial venture.
Label proposed, unbuilt and completed projects separately.
Preserve negative findings and name collisions.

findings.finding: Zero verified direct Trump–Netanyahu commercial joint ventures.
Four Trump-linked Israeli business clusters were resolved.
One implemented licensing arrangement and three proposed or failed development clusters were identified.
